context: Two coworkers compare weekday commute and lunch routines
purpose: Teach: 怪我/平日/うどん/パーセント/引く/映画館/食堂/出勤

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ゆきさん、平日の出勤って何時頃に家を出てますか?
lines.en: Yuki, what time do you leave home on weekdays for work?
lines.style: Casual workplace question, friendly inquiring tone between coworkers

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 七時半かな。電車が結構混むから、いつも壁際に立って人混みを避けるようにしてる。
lines.en: Around seven-thirty. The train gets pretty crowded, so I always stand by the wall to avoid the crush.
lines.style: Conversational reply with practical detail, slightly weary tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: わかる。先週なんて満員電車で足を踏まれて、ちょっとした怪我までしちゃいましたよ。
lines.en: I get it. Last week I got my foot stepped on in a packed train and even ended up with a little injury.
lines.style: Sympathetic complaint, light grumbling humor between peers

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: えー大丈夫?ちなみにお昼って毎日どうしてます?私はだいたい社員食堂ですよ。
lines.en: Oh no, are you okay? By the way, what do you do for lunch every day? I mostly use the company cafeteria.
lines.style: Concerned then pivots topic, casual office small talk

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 僕も食堂派。今日のうどん、出汁がすごく効いてて美味しかったですよ。
lines.en: I'm also a cafeteria person. Today's udon had really rich broth, it was delicious.
lines.style: Enthusiastic food recommendation, warm collegial sharing tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あ、それ食べ損ねた!社食って外より三十パーセントくらい安いって聞いて、毎日通っちゃう。
lines.en: Ah, I missed that one! I heard the company cafeteria is about thirty percent cheaper than outside, so I go every day.
lines.style: Regretful exclamation then practical observation, relatable office tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ですよね。あ、そういえば駅前の映画館、新しい作品始まりましたよ。気になってチラシ引いてきました。
lines.en: Right? Oh, that reminds me, the movie theater by the station started showing a new film. I grabbed a flyer because I was curious.
lines.style: Agreement transitioning to new topic, casual enthusiastic recommendation

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: へえ、行きたい!じゃあ今度の休みの日、一緒にどうですか?
lines.en: Oh, I want to go! Then how about on our day off this weekend, want to go together?
lines.style: Excited acceptance, friendly invitation extending casual coworker bond
